I have analyzed the gate report and the application files. The gate report indicates that all six drawing figures failed the OCR label review. The errors reported are "wrong figure label," "other text FIG," and "unexpected [figure number]" for each figure. This pattern suggests that the figure caption, such as "FIG. 1", is being misinterpreted by the OCR system, with "FIG" and the number being seen as separate, unexpected text elements rather than a single, valid figure label. The likely cause is the period in "FIG.", which can interfere with text parsing.

To resolve this, I will remove the period from the figure labels across the entire application. This involves changing "FIG. 1" to "FIG 1", "FIG. 2" to "FIG 2", and so on. This change will be applied consistently to:
1.  The `figure` frontmatter and the captioning instructions in all six figure brief files (`figures/FIG-*.md`).
2.  The Brief Description of the Drawings section (`draft/07-drawings.md`).
3.  All references to the figures within the Detailed Description (`draft/08-detailed-description.md`).

These changes are intended to make the figure labels unambiguous for the automated checking system, resolving all reported drawing failures. No other changes are necessary as the rest of the application appears to be in order.
